test.create_query: CREATE TABLE iceberg_top_k (k Int64, v Int64, m Int32, s String) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_top_k_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO iceberg_top_k SELECT (number % 100000) + 100000 * ((intDiv(number, 100000) * 37 + 11) % 200) AS k, toInt64(sipHash64(number)) AS v, number % 1000 AS m, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 20000000, iceberg_insert_max_bytes_in_data_file = 4294967296
test.query: SELECT k, s FROM iceberg_top_k ORDER BY k LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, s FROM iceberg_top_k ORDER BY k DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, s FROM iceberg_top_k ORDER BY v LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT m, s FROM iceberg_top_k ORDER BY m LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT m, count(), sum(v), max(length(s)) FROM iceberg_top_k GROUP BY m SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
